title.narrative: Court Information & Management System Development IDF Grant

description.narrative: Activities to be financed by the Grant includes the following: · Analysis of courts workload distribution and development of an automated case management system. · Development of an automated system for collecting, processing and maintaining of court statistics and to monitor performance indicators. · Preparation of the design and of the implementation plan for the new court information and management system. · Institutional strengthening of the Supreme Court and provision of necessary training, including study tours, to judges and other court personnel for the implementation and operation of the new court information and management system. · Implementation and testing of the new court information and management system, including acquisition of necessary equipment and software, on a pilot basis covering the Supreme Court, oblast courts and selected district courts. · Evaluation of the pilot activities on the implementation of the new court information and management system and preparation of recommendations regarding project expansion. It is understood that the development and installation of a new court management and information system throughout the country covering all 68 courts of general jurisdiction would probably require resources that can be supplied through IDF grant. Accordingly, the main objective of the proposed activities is the design of a court management and information system and its installation and testing in the Supre me Court, oblast courts (eight of them, including Bishkek City Court) and selected district courts. Based on the evaluation of these pilot activities the Kyrgyz Government is planning to expand the system for all city and district courts with the assistance of other donors. We believe that the activities financed by the IDF grant will have an important catalytic effect in this regard.
